content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a great day. I have reviewed the agreement and am excited to move forward. Before signing, I would like to suggest a minor adjustment: - Regarding the relevant clause, the current wording excludes certain obligations from the overall liability cap, which could lead to unlimited liability for third-party claims; we propose modifying this so that in no event shall either party's total liability arising out of the agreement exceed the total fees paid under it. Thank you for your time and flexibility. Best regards,
